name: Completed car tracking shows synchronized temporal observations
description: A real analysis run of the qualified synthetic video completes and shows distinct car identities, timestamped observations, and an overlay that follows playback time.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the Media Traffic application.
Upload the synthetic demo video at example/demo-traffic-video/source.mp4.
Open the scene configuration for the uploaded video.
Wait until the analysis run is completed or failed.
In the saved run records panel, verify the completed run reports multiple vehicle tracks for the uploaded source.
Open the completed run evidence and provenance.
In the run evidence panel, verify the uploaded-source identity, YOLO detector, and ByteTrack tracker details are visible.
Seek the video player to 0.6 seconds.
In the detected-vehicles overlay on the video frame, verify car boxes show distinct track IDs at the displayed playback timestamp and the overlay status states that positions are not interpolated.
